header: What a standard household connection includes
lead: These figures cover about nine in ten connections. Larger connections, farms and sites with their own transformer are planned individually.
caption: Single-phase and three-phase household connections, conditions valid from 1 January 2027
note: Prices exclude VAT. Ground conditions, road crossings and reinstatement are charged separately at cost. Published 1 December 2026.

rows.title: Connection rating
rows.text: Above 30 kVA, we design and quote each connection individually.

rows.title: Main fuse
rows.text: 63 A on request if an electric car and a heat pump share the connection.

rows.title: Service cable
rows.text: Aluminium, laid at a depth of 70 cm.

rows.title: Metering
rows.text: Records every 15 minutes and is read remotely once a day.

rows.title: Metering point
rows.text: In the outside wall, accessible without entering the building.

rows.title: Connection fee
rows.text: For a cable run of up to 25 m from the street boundary.

rows.title: Lead time
rows.text: From signed contract to fitted meter, outside the winter break.
